research_question: How should mid-market B2B software vendors price and govern AI features that call third-party frontier models when vendor margins and customer data-residency clauses conflict through 2027?

scope: Synthetic source pack only (same as Day-2 / 2026-10-15 original-condition retest). Cover margin vs residency, contracting patterns, options/kill-criteria through 2027. Distinct from open-weight lock-in. No live web. Change = Toolkit 1.1.0→1.3.0.

depth: Lite original-condition retest (version regression); long-form commercial mechanism memo.
evidence_standard: Synthetic sources disclosed; disclose fictional evidence; disclose no independent review.
